description: Search LinkedIn job postings by keyword and location, with LinkedIn's own filters. Returns each posting's title, company, location, listed_at, URL, and workplace_type and easy_apply where the list shows them. employment_type, seniority_level, salary and description are null: linkedin/job gives them. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

company_id.description: Only one company's roles: `company_id` in linkedin/company.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

easy_apply.description: Only roles that take applications on LinkedIn.

experience_level.description: Only roles at this level, as LinkedIn's filter names them.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

limit.description: At most this many results, 1–25. A page can hold fewer while `next_cursor` is set: read until it is null.

posted_within.description: Only roles posted in the last day, week or month.

query.description: Job title or keywords, e.g. "backend engineer".

sort.description: Most relevant first, or newest first.

workplace_type.description: Only roles of this kind, as LinkedIn's filter names them.

name: search_linkedin_jobs
title: Search LinkedIn job postings
